seaHouseShipment.docDeliveryInstructions:
ECB has to be presented to addresses at latest 3 working days after departure of vessel. In case of any difficulties, new vessel booking ordelays, please inform the responsible Transport Manager. Please send documents depending on Notify to: BDP,,basfdocs@bdpint.com
The followings must be shown on B/L: IMDG-class, UN number and propper shipping name in case of dangerous goods cargo. PO# must appear on waybill. Waybill must include number of individual collis per pallet and the sum of individual collis.
For bulk-containers: - tare weight is to be mentioned on the B/L - stock-number must be included, if mentioned in the order.
